summary: CMB.TECH NV filed a Form 6-K containing a press release dated November 12, 2026, announcing that it will report third-quarter 2026 earnings before market open on November 26, 2026, followed by a video conference call at 8 a.m. EST / 2 p.m. CET with an accompanying slide presentation. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings-scheduling notice for a NYSE- and Euronext-listed Belgian maritime group; no special-situation angle applies.
